UAE_MOE.notesEn: The UAE secondary certificate (Al-Thanawaya Al-Aama) is not accepted for direct entry; students must complete an approved international foundation course.

UAE_MOE.quote: Due to differences in the UK and UAE education systems, students with the Al-Thanawaya Al-Aama will be required to follow an approved international foundation course.

CBSE.notesEn: Direct entry usually needs 80 to 95% overall depending on the programme; subject requirements vary.
CBSE.notesAr: يتطلب القبول المباشر عادة معدلا عاما بين 80 و95% حسب البرنامج، وتختلف متطلبات المواد.
CBSE.quote: Students completing Higher Secondary School Certificates at the end of CBSE/ISC Standard XII will usually be considered for direct entry to the first year of undergraduate courses provided they have achieved a minimum of 80-95% overall.

ISC.notesEn: Direct entry usually needs 80 to 95% overall depending on the programme; subject requirements vary.
ISC.notesAr: يتطلب القبول المباشر عادة معدلا عاما بين 80 و95% حسب البرنامج، وتختلف متطلبات المواد.
ISC.quote: Students completing Higher Secondary School Certificates at the end of CBSE/ISC Standard XII will usually be considered for direct entry to the first year of undergraduate courses provided they have achieved a minimum of 80-95% overall.

AMERICAN.notesEn: US High School Diploma with a GPA of 3.0 plus three AP tests or dual enrolment classes in separate subjects (including any subject requirements).
AMERICAN.notesAr: شهادة الثانوية الأمريكية بمعدل 3.0 مع ثلاثة اختبارات AP أو مقررات جامعية بالتسجيل المزدوج في مواد مختلفة (بما فيها المواد المطلوبة).
AMERICAN.quote: Our A-level requirements can typically be met through a combination of: three AP tests or dual enrolment/college level classes taken during high school in separate subjects (including any subject requirements), plus completion of the High School Diploma (for which we do require a specific GPA of 3.0).

IB.quote: 36 points overall. 6,6,6 in Higher Level subjects

CBSE.notesEn: No lower than 80% in any subject and an average of at least 85% including English; Standard X Maths at 70% or Maths in Standard XII.
CBSE.notesAr: لا تقل أي مادة عن 80% ومعدل لا يقل عن 85% يشمل اللغة الإنجليزية، مع 70% في رياضيات الصف العاشر أو دراسة الرياضيات في الصف الثاني عشر.
CBSE.quote: We require no lower than 80% in any subject, with a minimum average of 85% which must include English.

ISC.notesEn: CISCE Standard XII: no lower than 80% in any subject and an average of at least 85% including English.
ISC.notesAr: الصف الثاني عشر من CISCE: لا تقل أي مادة عن 80% ومعدل لا يقل عن 85% يشمل اللغة الإنجليزية.
ISC.quote: We require no lower than 80% in any subject, with a minimum average of 85% which must include English.

subjects.quote: USA High School Graduation Diploma with an overall GPA of 3.0 including grade B in Mathematics and English Language. PLUS three APs with scores 5, 5, 5.

AMERICAN.notesAr: بالإضافة إلى ثلاثة اختبارات AP بدرجات 5 و5 و5.
AMERICAN.quote: USA High School Graduation Diploma with an overall GPA of 3.0 including grade B in Mathematics and English Language. PLUS three APs with scores 5, 5, 5.

UAE_MOE.quote: You will need acceptable qualifications such as A-levels or the International Baccalaureate, or you will need to complete a recognised international foundation year course.

english.quote: International English Language Testing System (IELTS) 6.5 overall with no less than 6 in any individual component.
70 overall with no less than 65 in any individual component.

subjects.quote: 37 points overall with 7,6,6 in Higher Level subjects, including 7 in Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches.

IB.quote: 37 points overall with 7,6,6 in Higher Level subjects, including 7 in Mathematics: Analysis and Approaches.

Grade 5 in AP Physics or Computer Science

TOEFL iBT 90 overall, with no subskill below 22

additional.quote: It is only possible to hold an offer for one course in the Department of Computer Science (for Year 1 entry).

AAA including Mathematics and either Physics, Electronics, Further Mathematics, Chemistry or Computer Science.

37 points overall with 7,6,6 in Higher Level subjects, including 7 in Higher Level Mathematics and 6 in Higher Level Physics or Chemistry.

IB.quote: 37 points overall with 7,6,6 in Higher Level subjects, including 7 in Higher Level Mathematics and 6 in Higher Level Physics or Chemistry.

subjects.quote: Biology/Human Biology or Chemistry; and
One of the following subjects from Chemistry; Biology/Human Biology; Physics; Psychology; Mathematics or Further Mathematics.

BRITISH.notesAr: AAA تشمل الأحياء أو الكيمياء إضافة إلى مادة علمية ثانية من القائمة.

subjects.quote: Major subjects must include Chemistry or Biology, plus another science (one from Chemistry, Biology, Physics, Psychology or Mathematics) and one further subject at Higher Level.

IB.notesEn: 6,6,6 at Higher Level; Maths and English Language at GCSE grade B (6) if not in the Diploma.
IB.notesAr: 6،6،6 في المستوى العالي؛ الرياضيات واللغة الإنجليزية بدرجة B (6) في GCSE إذا لم تكونا ضمن الدبلوم.
IB.quote: 36 points overall. 6,6,6, in Higher Level subjects.

english.quote: International English Language Testing Service (IELTS): A minimum average score of 7.0 and with not less than 6.5 in any one component taken at the same sitting;
Pearson Test of English (PTE) Academic: An overall score of 65 with no less than 65 in each of the communicative skills domains taken at the same sitting;
Cambridge English: Advanced (CAE), or Cambridge English: Proficiency (CPE): An overall score of 185 with no less than 185 in each of the scoring domains taken at the same sitting;

tests.noteEn: Applicants with SJT Band 3 or 4 are not considered; the UCAT threshold is set each year.
tests.noteAr: لا يُنظر في المتقدمين الحاصلين على الفئة 3 أو 4 في اختبار الحكم الظرفي، ويُحدَّد الحد الأدنى لـ UCAT سنويا.
tests.quote: Applicants are required to sit the University Clinical Aptitude Test (UCAT) in the year they wish to make their application.

additional.noteEn: No offers are made without interview.
additional.noteAr: لا تُقدَّم أي عروض دون مقابلة.
additional.quote: We do not make any offers without interview.

additional.noteEn: Relevant work experience is required before applying.
additional.noteAr: يُشترط اكتساب خبرة عملية ذات صلة قبل التقديم.
additional.quote: We require applicants to undertake some relevant work experience prior to application in order that they can gain some insight into what the role of a doctor involves.

additional.noteEn: International applicants should email ug.medicine@manchester.ac.uk to check requirements for their country before applying.
additional.noteAr: على المتقدمين الدوليين مراسلة ug.medicine@manchester.ac.uk للتحقق من متطلبات بلدهم قبل التقديم.
additional.quote: Please contact us at ug.medicine@manchester.ac.uk to check specific requirements for your country before you apply for the Medicine course.

AMERICAN.notesEn: Advanced Placement tests at 5, 5, 4 in specific subjects.
AMERICAN.notesAr: اختبارات AP بدرجات 5 و5 و4 في مواد محددة.

additional.quote: You will be required to attend a Microsoft Teams interview.

UAE_MOE.notesEn: Applicants from the Emirati high school system (Tawjihiya) must complete a foundation course before undergraduate entry.
UAE_MOE.notesAr: يجب على المتقدمين من نظام الثانوية الإماراتي (التوجيهية) إكمال برنامج تأسيسي قبل الالتحاق بالبكالوريوس.
UAE_MOE.quote: If you are applying from the Emirati High School system or Tawjahiya (Secondary School Leaving Certificate) you must complete a foundation course for entry to our undergraduate programmes.

CBSE.notesEn: Based on the average of the four best subjects. The percentage rises with the course's A-level offer: A*AA 93%, AAA 90%, AAB 87%, ABB 84%, BBB 80%, BBC 78%, BCC 75%.
CBSE.notesAr: يُحتسب متوسط أفضل أربع مواد. ترتفع النسبة مع عرض A-level للبرنامج: A*AA ‏93%، AAA ‏90%، AAB ‏87%، ABB ‏84%، BBB ‏80%، BBC ‏78%، BCC ‏75%.

ISC.notesEn: CISCE board uses the same scale as CBSE: A*AA 93%, AAA 90%, down to BCC 75%.
ISC.notesAr: يستخدم مجلس CISCE السلم نفسه المستخدم لـ CBSE: ‏A*AA ‏93%، AAA ‏90%، وصولا إلى BCC ‏75%.

AMERICAN.notesEn: Minimum of three approved AP exams from 5,5,5 to 4,4,4 depending on the course (or Honors / dual enrolment classes). A US diploma without APs or SAT IIs usually needs a foundation course.
AMERICAN.notesAr: ثلاثة اختبارات AP معتمدة على الأقل بدرجات بين 5،5،5 و4،4،4 حسب البرنامج (أو مقررات Honors أو التسجيل المزدوج). وتتطلب الشهادة الأمريكية دون AP أو SAT II عادة برنامجا تأسيسيا.
AMERICAN.quote: 3 approved AP Exams ranging between 5, 5, 5 to 4, 4, 4

subjects.quote: GCSE maths at grade B (5) and GCSE English at grade C (4)

additional.noteEn: Shortlisted applicants attend a multi-mini interview (MMI).

additional.noteEn: Personal statement must have a clear pharmacy focus.
additional.noteAr: يجب أن يركز البيان الشخصي بوضوح على الصيدلة.

additional.noteEn: Must be at least 18 by the end of the calendar year of entry.

additional.quote: You must be at least 18 years old by the end of the calendar year you start your MPharm degree to meet the requirements of the placements within your course.

additional.noteEn: Health and good character checks; vaccinations required.
additional.noteAr: فحوص صحية وفحص حسن السيرة، مع لقاحات مطلوبة.
